title: The Pursuit of Happyness
synopsis: A struggling salesman tries to keep his family together, raise his young son and survive an unpaid stockbroker internship while searching for a way out of homelessness.
credit: Retold from the true story of Chris Gardner. Original dialogue and scene wording.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Chris Gardner is a hardworking salesman in San Francisco, living with his wife, Linda, and their young son, Christopher. He has put almost all of his savings into portable bone-density scanners.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: He believes that selling them to medical professionals will make his family secure. But the scanners are expensive, and the hospitals are slow to buy.

scenes.speaker: chris
scenes.text: This one is lighter and faster than the old equipment. Give me ten minutes of your day, and let me show you.

scenes.speaker: linda
scenes.text: Chris, I am working long hours to hold this house together, and you keep chasing a sale that never comes. I cannot do this much longer.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The arguments grow more frequent, and the marriage slowly falls apart. Linda decides she can no longer cope, and leaves San Francisco for a job in New York. Christopher stays with his father.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: One day, Chris sees a wealthy man step out of an expensive sports car. Curious, he walks over and asks him what he does for a living.

scenes.speaker: broker
scenes.text: I am a stockbroker. I help people invest in the stock market, and that is how I make my money.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The answer changes everything. Chris begins to believe that becoming a stockbroker could give him the stability he is desperate for.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: He decides to apply for an internship at Dean Witter Reynolds, a major brokerage firm. But many candidates are competing for it, and most have better money and better qualifications.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Chris finally gets an interview with the management. But just before it, he is arrested for failing to pay his parking tickets, and he spends the night in jail.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The next morning, he has no time to prepare, and he arrives looking untidy.

scenes.speaker: manager
scenes.text: You are not exactly dressed for an interview. Tell us why we should take you seriously.

scenes.speaker: chris
scenes.text: I am honest about where I am, and I learn fast. Give me a chance, and I will work harder than anyone here.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Despite his appearance, he impresses the interviewers with his intelligence, his confidence and his honesty. He is selected for a six-month training programme.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: There is one major problem. The internship is unpaid, and only one trainee will receive a permanent job at the end.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Now Chris must raise his young son alone, attend the internship, and keep selling his scanners.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: His finances become desperate. He falls behind on rent, and he and Christopher are forced to leave their apartment.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Father and son move from place to place, looking for somewhere to sleep. Some nights they stay in homeless shelters. Other nights they have nowhere to go.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: In one heartbreaking moment, they spend the night inside a public restroom at a subway station. Chris locks the door and sits on the floor to protect his sleeping son, fighting back tears.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Despite everything, he refuses to let his son lose hope.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Every morning, he attends the internship in his best clothes. He learns to talk to clients, make investment calls and understand the market.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: With no time and no money to spare, he becomes extremely efficient. He makes calls continuously, takes no unnecessary breaks, and works to attract clients.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: He also keeps selling his remaining scanners. At one point, a doctor who had shown interest finally buys one, giving him a little relief, though his bigger problems remain.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Throughout the internship, he earns a reputation for being hardworking, intelligent and determined, and his supervisor begins to notice.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: But he knows that hard work may not be enough. As the final day approaches, he becomes anxious. He has sacrificed almost everything, and failure would mean returning to the same difficult circumstances.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Eventually, Chris is called into his manager's office.

scenes.speaker: manager
scenes.text: You have successfully completed the internship. We are offering you the full-time position.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: For a moment, Chris struggles to contain his emotions. He thanks the management, leaves the office, and walks into the street. Overwhelmed with happiness, he begins clapping as tears fill his eyes.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: He later becomes a successful stockbroker, and eventually establishes his own investment firm. Circumstances do not have to decide a person's future. Success is not about having the best starting point. It is about refusing to give up when everything around you seems to be falling apart.
